subtitle: Whose credentials should actually sit behind an integration?

steps.label: Not tied to one employee
steps.sub: the integration keeps working after that person leaves

steps.label: Owned by IT/security
steps.sub: password rotation and review don't depend on one person remembering

steps.label: Specific roles
steps.sub: job and duty roles scoped to the data the integration actually touches

steps.label: Specific business units
steps.sub: access limited to the BUs the integration is built for

steps.label: Specific resources
steps.sub: read-only where no write is ever required

code:
Personal login, used for an integration:
  Employee leaves -> integration breaks
  Password reset -> integration breaks
  Over-broad access -> audit risk

Dedicated integration user:
  Survives staff turnover, scoped, auditable
